text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- 14 people killed in Oued el Alleug south of Algiers, including one whole family.
- Nearly 100 civilians die in seven massacres in two weeks.
- Prime Minister Ouyahia, presiding over referendum campaign rally at Algiers's Bourouba suburb, says proposed constitution will bring dignity and social justice.
- Algeria inaugurates shipping line between Algiers and Spanish city of Alicante.

- Industry official says authorities have shut down more than 240 state-owned, loss-making enterprises since 1993. Workers, who lost their jobs, received compensation from state-funded unemployment insurance scheme.
